title: Outlook keeps asking for the password
symptom: Outlook repeatedly shows a password prompt
user_description: Outlook keeps popping up asking for my password, every few minutes. I type it in and a bit later it asks again.

options.text: Turn off multi-factor authentication so it stops asking
options.why: Removes an important protection and does not address the cause.

options.text: Tell him to keep typing it in
options.why: Ignores the fault and wastes his time all day.

options.text: Check whether his password changed recently, clear the old saved Outlook entries in Credential Manager, and sign in again, completing any multi-factor prompt
options.why: A password prompt that returns often means an old saved password no longer matches. Clearing the old entries and signing in again replaces them with the right ones.
Never the first step. It is a huge fix for something that is almost always a saved password.

hints: Why would Outlook ask again after it accepted the password?
What might still hold his old password?
Did anything change on his account recently?
real_world_tip: A password change on another device is a frequent trigger. Ask 'Did you change your password recently?'
